ننتهز (form VIII)
# نَنْتَهِزُ (nantahizu) /nan.ta.hi.zu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# نُنْتَهَزُ (nuntahazu) /nun.ta.ha.zu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# نَنْتَهِزَ (nantahiza) /nan.ta.hi.za/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَهَزَ (intahaza)
# نُنْتَهَزَ (nuntahaza) /nun.ta.ha.za/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
